_comment: Example .mcp.json for Claude Code (project scope). 'shadcn' is the server RareUI's own docs point to (lib/mcp.ts); add the @rare-ui registry in components.json (see README). Package names verified on npm 2026-10-13: shadcn 4.21.4, @21st-dev/magic 0.2.3, @magicuidesign/mcp 2.0.0. The 21st.dev API_KEY env var name follows its README convention and is UNVERIFIED here; Magic UI MCP needs no key (unverified).
